scripts.build: pnpm --filter kakoune-core-js build && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune build && pnpm --filter playground build && pnpm --filter obsidian-kakoune build && pnpm build:cm5 && pnpm build:extension
scripts.build:lib: pnpm --filter kakoune-core-js build && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune build && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune-cm5 build
scripts.build:cm5: pnpm --filter kakoune-core-js build && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune-cm5 build && pnpm --filter playground-cm5 build
scripts.build:extension: pnpm --filter kakoune-core-js build && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune build && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune-cm5 build && pnpm --filter browser-kakoune build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter kakoune-core-js test && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune test && pnpm --filter codemirror-kakoune-cm5 test && pnpm --filter browser-kakoune test

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-jsr-version.mjs && git add packages/codemirror-kakoune/jsr.json packages/kakoune-core/jsr.json packages/codemirror-kakoune-cm5/jsr.json packages/kakoune-core/package.json packages/codemirror-kakoune-cm5/package.json
